notes.title: The design of Malphas, Super Space Galaxy's first boss
notes.content:
In this video, I share my process for designing Malphas, the first boss in Super Space Galaxy.
Using my method, you can pretty much make up a boss as you go along! You just need to make it more interesting with every step.

notes.title: The 5th demo is here, with a massive combat update!
notes.content:
The 5th playable demo of Super Space Galaxy is here! (0.5.3)

The main new feature is a massive overhaul to the combat. There is now a grand total of 13 new enemy types to challenge you. Every planet type has unique enemies that appear only on that planet. This makes exploring the planets much more exciting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41615280/7022c47027da678348805c9a919caa8d4b383c0a.png[/img]

Any feedback is appreciated. You can use the 'Give feedback' button in the Links menu to tell me what you think.

notes.title: Want to learn how to make video games?
notes.content:
[i]Super Space Galaxy[/i] is made in [i]Clickteam Fusion 2.5[/i]. I've been using Clickteam products since the days of [i]Klik & Play[/i] in 1994, and while it can be a great tool, I know it's hard to get started. I had to figure out many things by myself over the years, and I want to pass some of that knowledge on to you. That's why I've decided to make a series of tutorials that make useful, complete features for your games.

[previewyoutube=x-EPJREh8O0;full][/previewyoutube]
Here's a [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x-EPJREh8O0]free tutorial[/url] I made on how to make a 'physics engine' in Clickteam Fusion. This physics system is the basis for the smooth movement in [i]Super Space Galaxy[/i] and it's a great foundation to build other things.

There are in-depth paid [url=https://www.patreon.com/plasmabeamgames/shop]tutorials on my Patreon[/url]. These are much longer and will give you powerful features for your games, like the colour-flashing effect that's used in [i]Super Space Galaxy[/i]. My Patreon members also get all the tutorials included in their membership, so you might find subscribing to my Patreon a great investment. I also plan to make a lot of 'free samples' so there'll be something for everyone.

Let me know what aspect of Clickteam Fusion you're interested in and I may make a tutorial for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41615280/3487253067df5718c81fdd19b5de054bfac5fd88.png[/img]

notes.title: The 4th playable demo of Super Space Galaxy is here!
notes.content:
The 4th playable demo of Super Space Galaxy is here! (0.4.5)

New features include:
- The game's first boss, Malphas, can be found in Nether Rifts. The Rifts will be on suns that appear red in the galaxy map. The game gets harder as you approach sources of the Nether, so come prepared with all the weapons you can find.
- Weather effects for planets: rain, snow and lava ash effects.
- The game now displays at a ratio of 16:9 to better fit most monitors.
- The currency display can show Pounds (£), Dollars ($) or Euros (€). (Makes no difference to gameplay.)
- When you land on a planet, you now start in the centre and not in the top-left.
- Drones have been made more fair to fight and don't surround you quite as much.
- I added so many new things I had to make an [url=https://discord.com/channels/1011369303947354162/1230572978312577184]'Improvements' page in the Discord[/url].

Any feedback is appreciated. I've already gotten a lot of useful ideas from players and a 5th demo is already in the works! I plan to add to the combat variety and improve the tutorial.

If you want to help support the game, [url=https://discord.gg/TpGE8yFEXa]join us on Discord[/url] or [url=https://www.patreon.com/PlasmaBeamGames]subscribe to my Patreon[/url].
